verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins offers digital tools through LathamDrive, including a document generator and glossary apps, so a public API is a fair question for this product. The evidence documents no API, though. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404, and none of the docs mention programmatic access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
